relics.name: Half-Open File
relics.desc: Your pieces, pawns and pawnlings in the bound lane move 8% faster; in the other two lanes 4% slower.
relics.rewards: One committed push lane.
relics.counter: Position: Barricade stalls the faster wave. Fortress: Hold the File outlasts it.

relics.name: Closed Position
relics.desc: Rally. Your Bastions in the bound lane take 20% less damage and your pieces there gain 10% armor and resist; your pawnlings there deal 15% less. Off while you are not behind.
relics.rewards: Lock a lane you cannot win and win elsewhere.
relics.counter: Sacrifice: Pawn Sacrifice ignores the cap. Battering Ram strips armor.

relics.name: Crown Jewel
relics.desc: The bound piece deals 8% more damage and has 8% more health; your other four pieces deal 3% less.
relics.rewards: Pick one carry and build the team around it.
relics.counter: Initiative: Check and Fork on the obvious target.

relics.name: Development
relics.desc: The bound piece earns 15% more gold and reaches its Rank 4 and Rank 8 forks sooner; the enemy earns 50% more bounty for killing it.
relics.rewards: Decide who reaches Rank 8 first.
relics.counter: Focus it: every kill pays the enemy more.

relics.name: Pawn Majority
relics.desc: Pawns cost 12 Tempo (from 15) and your pawn cap is 2 higher; your pawns have 10% less health.
relics.rewards: A pawn-heavy doctrine.
relics.counter: Area damage clears them. Fortress soaks cheap pushes.

relics.name: Pawn Lever
relics.desc: Your pawns and pawnlings in the bound lane deal 20% more damage to Bastions and the Throne (still under the per-second cap).
relics.rewards: Pick the lane to crack; send pawns and the Ram.
relics.counter: Fortress: Hold the File and Closed Position. A Bastion Rook.

relics.name: Opening Theory
relics.desc: Cards from your Opening's two schools cost 5 Tempo less; other schools cost 5 more. Italian Game: every card costs 2 less. No card costs less than 3.
relics.rewards: Commit to your Opening.
relics.counter: The schools that counter your Opening's.

relics.name: Standing Order
relics.desc: Pick a lane card and a lane: it is always on there at 40% strength (Pawn Storm at one third). The card leaves your deck while it is bound.
relics.rewards: A lane doctrine with no live taps.
relics.counter: The card's own school counter: Fortress and Position against March cards.

relics.name: Sealed Move
relics.desc: Pick one card from your Opening's schools (any school for Italian Game) and a trigger. Once per Act it plays itself when the trigger trips, aimed by the AI's targeting, for 10 Tempo less (never below 3). Short of Tempo it waits 5 seconds, then lapses.
relics.rewards: A pre-planned answer instead of a reflex.
relics.counter: The card's own school counter. A trigger the enemy can bait.

relics.name: Pawn Structure
relics.desc: Set a pawn quota for each lane (at most your pawn cap) and a Tempo reserve of 0, 20 or 40. A pawn is fielded on its own in any lane under quota while Tempo is at least its cost plus the reserve. Auto pawns cost 2 less. Field Pawn still works.
relics.rewards: A planned pawn plan instead of live taps.
relics.counter: Whatever kills pawns. Poisoned Pawn and Clock drain the reserve.

relics.name: Wing Gambit
relics.desc: You give up the bound lane: your Bastions there take 15% more damage. Every pawnling wave in your other two lanes gets 1 more melee pawnling.
relics.rewards: Give up one lane to overload two.
relics.counter: An Errant or a Ram split-pushes the conceded lane. March pushes it fast.

relics.name: Strong Square
relics.desc: From each Act start a banner stands at the bound lane's river crossing all Act: allies within 160 gain 10 armor and 10 resist. An enemy piece that stands alone on it for 5 seconds topples it until the next Act.
relics.rewards: Hold a choke without spending cards.
relics.counter: Initiative: kill the holders, then topple it.

relics.name: Guarded Piece
relics.desc: The bound piece takes 12% less damage while another of your pieces is within 300.
relics.rewards: Pair pieces in one lane (set in Orders).
relics.counter: Position: Barricade or Regroup splits the pair. Lancer dives.

relics.name: Knight's Tour
relics.desc: Your Knight moves 15% faster out of combat, deals 25% more damage to camps and earns 4 Tempo for each camp it clears.
relics.rewards: A roaming Knight that feeds Tempo.
relics.counter: Initiative: the lone Knight is a Fork or Check target.

relics.name: King's Ransom
relics.desc: Rally. While you are in Check, the 10% team damage penalty is lifted and your other pieces take 10% less damage. King respawn time is unchanged. Off while you are not behind.
relics.rewards: Play a brave King without collapsing when he falls.
relics.counter: Push the Throne during Check: the Throne itself gains nothing.

relics.name: Pawn Chain
relics.desc: Each of your pawns gains 4% damage and armor for every other pawn of yours within 150 (at most 12%).
relics.rewards: Field pawns in clumps in one lane.
relics.counter: Area damage (Regent, Shadow). Barricade splits the chain.

relics.name: Spare Tempo
relics.desc: Your Tempo cap is 130 (from 100). At each Act start you gain 10% of the Tempo you hold, at most 10.
relics.rewards: Bank for a planned burst (Check and Fork cost 75).
relics.counter: March: steady cheap pressure while you save.

relics.name: Compensation
relics.desc: Rally. While you start an Act behind: your pawn cap is 2 higher and you earn 0.25 more Tempo per second for that Act.
relics.rewards: Rebuild with pawns after a bad Act.
relics.counter: Stay even: it switches off.

relics.name: Curtain Wall
relics.desc: Your Bastions have 15% more health. Outer Bastions regain 0.5% health per second when no enemy unit has been within 300 for 5 seconds.
relics.rewards: Turtle early, win late with the Queen.
relics.counter: March: any pawn near the wall stops the regen. Pawn Sacrifice.

relics.name: Royal Keep
relics.desc: Your Throne has 20% more health and deals 25% more damage. In Endgame (Act 7 and on) your Throne takes 25% more damage instead of 50%.
relics.rewards: A late game with a slow, strong Queen.
relics.counter: Siege early, before Endgame.

relics.name: Quiet Move
relics.desc: Your hand is 2 cards (from 3), played cards come back in 4 seconds (from 6), and you earn 20% more Tempo.
relics.rewards: Fewer live decisions, more pawns or Sealed Move.
relics.counter: Initiative: you hold fewer answers to a pick.

relics.name: Battery
relics.desc: Your lanes may be 3/1/1, with three pieces in the bound lane (taking it moves your pieces). The two lone pieces gain 10% armor and resist.
relics.rewards: A three-piece hammer in one lane.
relics.counter: Area damage (Regent, Shadow) on the stack. March on a thin lane. Barricade.

relics.name: Sortie
relics.desc: Rally. The first time each of your Bastions drops below 50%, the nearest piece from another lane rotates to defend it for 20 seconds, and your pieces in that lane deal 15% more damage for 12 seconds. Off while you are not behind.
relics.rewards: Planned rotations instead of a live Regroup.
relics.counter: Split-push the lane the rotator left. Barricade blocks the path.
